SUMMARY: Core cutover mechanics (default on, per-scope allowlist, tenant-bound Go store, preflight/backup discipline, export/prune tooling) are directionally correct and several prior majors are closed.
Ship-blocking: generated-product "parity evidence" is tautological — DB exported and compared to itself — so AC-3 is not demonstrated for PF-GP.

Highest residual risks: missing authority metrics despite the approved observability contract, payload mutation in export breaking the documented rollback parity step, and stale 743-item evidence that no longer matches the tree.
Recommend: backfill real PF-GP file sources and compare against them, emit/assert the `edp_backlog_authority_*` metrics, and regenerate AC evidence at the frozen SHA before merge.
